statement: The first line holds q. Each of the next q lines is one of: insert w, search w, prefix w. Execute them against a trie that starts empty and print the results of every search and prefix on one line, space-separated, as yes or no. search w asks whether w was inserted as a whole word; prefix w asks whether any inserted word starts with w. Reaching a node proves a prefix exists - only the end-of-word flag proves a word ends there.

example.input:
6
insert apple
search apple
search app
prefix app
insert app
search app
example.why: app is a prefix of apple but no word, until its own insert flips the flag.

hint: One walk serves all three operations; they differ only in what the final node must prove.
mistake: Answering search from path-existence alone - every prefix of a stored word then counts as a word.

tests.input:
6
insert apple
search apple
search app
prefix app
insert app
search app

3
search x
insert x
search x

4
insert ab
prefix abc
prefix ab
search abc
